parsed_json.up: Return molecule details for all compounds reported in the specified document. Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Source data from the document, compound records, molecule dictionary, and compound structures tables. Join document records to compound records, then to molecule dictionary, and finally to compound structures. Filter by the document ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1122023'. Sort the results by the molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
